Interior start offset: splitPair(offset)? Not checked. Requirement: "reject an interior start". Current code doesn't reject interior start. Need to add check: if offset is interior of surrogate pair, reject. Also interior end moved backward — done via splitPair(end) end--. But if offset+max_chars makes end==offset after decrement and offset not EOF... handled.

Add: need(!splitPair(offset), 'inspection-range-splits-unicode')? Better own code, but any code fine. Add check that offset isn't low surrogate start: splitPair(offset) means text[offset-1] high, text[offset] low → interior start → reject.
